Specification: This module provides Apalache-specific type annotations and concrete helper values for a distributed replicated log specification. It models a system with a set of servers, a set of values, an integer lag constant, and a single state variable cLogs mapping each server to a sequence of values representing its current log. The module also instantiates another module named DistributedReplicatedLog, but this file itself only defines the typed variable tuple vars and two concrete set-valued helper operators for servers and values; it contains no actions, temporal specification, fairness, or proof content.
